body: [opus 5.5] 2026-09-25 21:55Z: the private voice backend's speech route is restored. One live smoke passed: greeting and one text prompt each produced audible PCM and an agent transcript, both response groups completed, 0 failed. First assistant audio came 861 ms after the greeting request and 57 ms after the text prompt. Details and route info are kept in private evidence only. Test-harness note: after the client sends audio_end, the bridge replies with an immediate turn_complete ack. Acceptance drivers must consume that ack before sending the next input.

author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Final live acceptance, 2026-09-25 23:48–23:51Z. One sequential, read-only session on the deployed 1a9baed build. The served voice.js matched the landed hash. The front-door sign-in hop was bypassed: the page and websocket went through the local ingress, with the websocket path and read-scope credential unchanged. The front-door hop is covered by the owner's signed-in phone test. #11 voice-connect-latency: PASS. The readiness timing record is content-free and has all 7 phases, in ms after the press: session_acquired 476, microphone_ready 498, socket_open 521, provider_ready 552, greeting_audio_received 1066, greeting_audible 1117, greeting_text 1593. The largest gap, provider_ready to greeting_audio_received at 514 ms, is time spent in the voice backend. The greeting was audible: 92 frames, 3680 ms of audio, peak 7440, with turn_complete at 4739 ms. Closing.
